description: Source code for handling email notifications in Mattermost, including building email content, sending emails, and generating email subjects for different notification types.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for email notification handling.

methods.name: buildEmailNotification
methods.description: Constructs an EmailNotification object with content tailored to the notification type and user preferences.

methods.name: sendNotificationEmail
methods.description: Prepares and sends an email notification, including plugin hooks, batching, and email content rendering.

methods.name: getDirectMessageNotificationEmailSubject
methods.description: Generates email subject line for direct messages.

methods.name: getNotificationEmailSubject
methods.description: Generates email subject line for group and team notifications.

methods.name: getGroupMessageNotificationEmailSubject
methods.description: Generates email subject line for group message notifications.

methods.name: truncateUserNames
methods.description: Truncates user display names longer than specified length, appending ellipsis.

methods.name: GetMessageForNotification
methods.description: Retrieves the message content for a notification post.

methods.name: getNotificationEmailBodyFromEmailNotification
methods.description: Renders the email body content from an EmailNotification object.
